title: David and Romeo Beckham join England fans singing Wonderwall as Three Lions beat Norway
text:
00:09

Removed from bookmarks

David Beckham and his son, Romeo Beckham, celebrated England’s victory over Norway by singing “Wonderwall” alongside fans on Saturday (11 May).

Jude Bellingham sent the Three Lions to a fourth-ever World Cup semi-final as Thomas Tuchel’s men edged past Norway 2-1 in extra time.

The Oasis hit has become an unofficial anthem of the football tournament, with the England squad joining together to sing it back to fans after matches.

England will next face either Argentina or Switzerland on Wednesday evening.
